scope: Instruction-grounded behavioral checks. No new alternative has been read during contract design.

000081.test_all_continues_and_summarizes_all_re: Run every collected example; print failures and N / M passed summary.
000081.test_named_failure_propagates: A single named example must propagate failure immediately.
000081.test_supplied_argv_controls_verbosity_an: argv=['all', '--quiet'] and argv flags must control the programmatic call, not sys.argv.
000081.test_leading_flag_is_not_a_test_name: Leading flag defaults to no command; baseline public no-command behavior lists tests.
000081.test_supplied_style_overrides_process_st: Supplied argv controls style; baseline public flags include --freeform and --google.

000682.test_encryption_policy_exposes_selected_: Enable SNS topic encryption with a selected KMS key and disable it. TopicArn/KmsMasterKeyId and AWS set_topic_attributes are baseline public AWS interfaces. Registration and configuration names are discovered, never pinned.
000682.test_kms_attribute_and_alias_filtering: Match topics through KMS id, arn, alias and key attributes; select topics not using an approved key. key/value/not policy syntax and c7n:AliasName come from public baseline filtering conventions. No subclass, helper, exact schema dictionary, registration name or return-value assertion is required.
000682.limits: Schema-driven action discovery currently supports a combined boolean encryption toggle and selected-key string. A correct implementation exposing separate enable/disable actions could need a broader public-interface adapter; do not claim universal acceptance from this check alone.

002139.test_download_filenames_path_and_status: Use bb.fetch2.Fetch, both instruction filename examples, stripped storage object path, target bytes and existence check.
002139.test_notfound_missing_and_empty_download: FetchError for NotFound, absent target or zero bytes; remove zero-byte file.
002139.test_missing_status_and_network_access: Missing blob raises FetchError; normal BitBake network prohibition blocks download/existence API use. Client construction alone is not treated as network access.
002139.limits: A minimal Google SDK fake implements the documented Client.bucket(...).blob(...), download_to_filename and exists interfaces. It does not pin client construction arguments or implementation module names.

003007.test_status_booleans: is_cleaning/is_charging properties for the public baseline status vocabulary; active modes exclude stop/returning/charging/idle/offline.
003007.test_importable_vocabulary_without_const: Named importable constants for clean modes, fan speeds, charge modes and components. Names are unconstrained; values come from public baseline dictionaries.
003007.test_login_diagnostics_use_library_logge: Existing login warning must use a sucks-scoped logger. No message text or debug-call count is pinned.
003007.limits: Historical 3 mutants only delete debug calls. The instruction requires scoped logging, not preservation of each debug message. Surviving deletion mutants are not automatically semantic defects.

001267.limits: No executable public browser harness is available. Reference-only model method tests are not used as public Gold assertions. All Gold cells remain unmeasured.

gates: G3/G4 are unexercised. G7 awaits parent-supplied blind alternatives. Certification remains incomplete.
